cases.oracle: Inspect a proposed reused component and reject missing revision/license information; preserve upstream notices.
A build-only fixture cannot become a qualified target or a passed native acceptance case.
Inspect registry ownership and reject duplicate IDs or contradictory reference mappings.
Invalid metadata, duplicate IDs, missing concepts and stale index fixtures fail validation.
Malformed catalog, traversal, symlink escape and unsupported-keyword fixtures fail with precise errors.
A synthetic passed-without-evidence entry is rejected and an empty evidence catalog leaves all cases not_run.
Compare text/JSON/TUI projections of a fixed snapshot and ensure identical units, identity and values.
Compile the core under strict C90 checks and inspect public headers; a 16-bit-width fixture must not silently truncate.
Audit linked/imported dependencies and launch the delivered application from an arbitrary clean folder.
A fixture reuses a PID between snapshots and an action; the old selection is retired and action is refused.
Independent arithmetic fixtures cover zero/full load, resets, PID reuse, counter wrap, zero time, missing rows and access denial.
Feed a fixed snapshot through each projection and compare exact counters plus documented derived ratios.
Boundary and malformed-provider fixtures cannot overflow, hang, emit nonfinite JSON or present partial data as complete.
A deliberately slow collector stays within its declared in-flight/queue bounds and leaves input responsive where promised.
Exercise close, resize, interrupt, provider failure and repeated shutdown under memory/handle checks.
An uncooperative provider fixture cannot produce a false bounded-shutdown pass.
Inspect artifact imports/header/runtime records; no targeted or build-only profile becomes supported.
DOS/Win16/CE/RT fixture profiles expose only declared capabilities and precise unavailable reasons.
A modern-host cross-build/import record cannot satisfy the historical runtime case.
Table-driven parser cases cover default/TUI/snapshot/format, missing values, duplicates, conflicts, overflows and --gui exit2.
Use an injected collector/console spy and redirected output; information commands perform zero samples and no console mutation.
Parse JSON with an independent parser and compare fixed counters/status against model fixtures, including hostile process names.
Exercise zero rows, shrinking lists, PID reuse, tree cycles and small/rapidly resized terminals.
A feature audit maps each interaction to an acceptance case and observed implementation status; missing features remain planned.
Control-byte, long-name, Unicode-width and invalid-theme fixtures cannot inject terminal commands or corrupt layout.
Run from a different working directory with explicit, adjacent, legacy and user sentinel configs, denied/malformed paths and --no-config; verify read source, precedence and zero writes.
Read-only portable, multi-user and side-by-side install fixtures preserve sentinels and disclose inability to save.
Malformed, oversized, unknown-key and interrupted-save fixtures cannot execute content or destroy the original.
Compare payload hashes across ZIP/setup/MSI and verify license/source-offer obligations before release.
Per-user/system/portable/side-by-side and interrupted-update fixtures preserve sentinel files and recover the previous app.
Reject mismatched version/profile/hash manifests and inspect downloaded bytes before a release support claim.
Rebuild a named lane and inspect the produced machine/subsystem/import/CRT data against its profile.
A missing compiler or failed gate appears as unavailable/failed in evidence, never pass.
Strict core build and adversarial width/encoding fixtures expose truncation and invalid conversions.
Run as an ordinary user against own and protected processes; inspect requested rights and verify no policy/service change.
PID-reuse, exit-race, denied-right and hostile-name fixtures cannot affect the wrong process or launch an unintended command.
Malformed variable-record, offset overflow and unterminated-string fixtures fail safely within declared bounds.
Missing logs, changed source, invented IDs and empty evidence are rejected; a valid scoped record does not certify other targets.
Review a benchmark and a native compatibility record against required conditions; unknown measurements remain unknown.
A multi-attempt evidence fixture keeps original failure records and attaches the later pass to its own exact subject.
Inspect manifest, source/import/native records and acquired-byte hashes; a build-only package cannot pass release qualification.
Compare release metadata and package identity against the real published artifact; planned channels remain unavailable.
A cyclic/missing dependency or completed-without-evidence unit fails; next lists only admissible dependency-ready work.
Status output cannot turn a reserved command or targeted platform into an implemented/released feature.
Review a proposed extraction against its dependency/rights/test record and reject unsupported parity claims.
Compare independent key/action tables, modifiers and editing contexts; htop k requests termination while vi k navigates, with identical action guards.
Exercise main/help/setup/search/filter/confirmation states and narrow/short terminals; hints and hitboxes remain inside displayed cells and hiding the bar returns its space.
Inject click/wheel/header/tab/bar events, disabled/unsupported mouse and resize races; verify selection/sort/scroll outcomes, no accidental termination and restored modes.
Round-trip differing tab layouts, reordered/hidden columns and headers, active tab and sort direction; reject duplicate/out-of-range layouts and preserve inactive-tab state.

Exercise explicit/legacy/user destinations, unavailable folder lookup, denied/read-only/missing parent, external changes, existing-file preservation, temporary cleanup and restart round-trip; ordinary startup/exit makes no settings write.
Combine CLI keymap/theme/mouse/bar overrides with config/no-config and metadata; invalid/conflicting forms fail before collection and write-config performs no process sample.
